subject: AWS Marketplace listing — content architecture & runbook
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice@orbitanalytics.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Marketplace listing — next steps for content & co-sell readiness

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the run-through today. Orbit is excited to get the AWS listing live and start the co-sell motions with your field. Before we hand off to procurement, a couple of asks from our side:

- Can you share a short runbook for the listing setup steps (what we own vs. what Redwood will submit in the Seller Central UI)?
- We’ve drafted hero/topline copy but need help mapping it to the AWS tile taxonomy (use cases, SKU names, trial entitlements). Can your team suggest the canonical field-to-copy mapping?
- Orbit will provide the evidence bundle for trust claims (SOC2 attestation, architecture diagram). Where should we upload it and what naming convention do you prefer?

Attached: orbit-listing-draft-v0.2.docx (draft hero + bullets).

Procurement contact is procurement@orbitanalytics.com — they will loop in the DPA/PO stuff once the listing copy is finalized.

Appreciate a short checklist and an expected timeline.

Best,
Alice Park
Head of Partnerships
Orbit Analytics

Attachment: orbit-listing-draft-v0.2.docx (file stub)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Alice Park <alice@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing — next steps for content & co-sell readiness

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kim and Jonas from Marketplace & Partnerships to help with the runbook and taxonomy mapping.

Quick answers and next steps:

1) Runbook (attached): I’ve attached a short runbook that breaks down: Redwood responsibilities (Seller Central submission, AMI tagging guidance if BYO model), Orbit responsibilities (legal evidence, logos, billing contacts), and joint steps (co-sell enablement assets).

2) Field-to-copy mapping: see the attached mapping sheet in the runbook — we recommend you provide: one-line product summary, 3-4 top use cases (short bullets), 2 example screenshots with captions, and trial entitlement wording. We’ll map those into AWS fields and share a preview.

3) Evidence upload: Please upload to the Drive link below and name files with the pattern ORBIT_EVIDENCE_<type>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf (example: ORBIT_EVIDENCE_SOC2_20261101.pdf). We’ll pull into the evidence binder for the listing.

Timeline: If you can return the completed runbook and final hero copy by EOD Nov 22, we can submit a Seller Central draft by Nov 25 and request an internal AWS review the following week.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_listing_assets (upload folder)

Attachments: orbit-listing-draft-v0.3.docx (I copied your edits into our recommended format), evidence-binder-summary.pdf (template).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a short 30m sync if helpful.

—
Jasmine Liu
Partner Marketing (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace listing — content architecture & runbook (internal alignment)

Team — quick internal alignment notes (summarizing what I’ll include in the Seller Central draft):

- Hero one-liner: keep crisp and benefits-first. Jasmine’s draft OK but shorten to 12-14 words max. Example proposal: "Server-grade LLM inference at predictable latency and cost across hosted and private deployments."
- Use cases: map Orbit’s bullets to three AWS buyer personas: Platform, Product, Security. I’ll provide microcopy variants per persona so the tile shows targeted benefits.
- SKU / trial naming: suggest SKU names reflect capacity tier (e.g., Orbit-Standard-1y-trial) — avoid model-specific names on the public tile.
- Evidence: we will reference the uploaded SOC2 PDF and architecture diagram in the evidence section. Ensure their architecture diagram obfuscates any customer-identifying traffic flows.
- AMI tagging: Jonas, can you confirm minimal tag requirements for BYO AMI? We should add a footnote in the runbook.

Action items:
- Marissa: create the short buyer persona snippets + one-sentence field mapping by EOD Nov 20.
- Jonas: confirm AMI tag minimums by Nov 19.
- Jasmine: once Orbit returns copy, you and I will walk through the Seller Central preview together.

Thanks — will be tight but feasible.

Kimberly Park
Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
